# UX Requirements Checklist: 会话消息交互改进

**Purpose**: Review completeness, clarity, consistency, and coverage of the user-facing interaction requirements  
**Created**: 2026-10-22  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` workflow based on the feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact.  
**Marker Semantics**: Mark `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied; this does not mean implementation is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the expected labels and fallback content defined when the API has no usable model configuration? [Gap, Spec §US3, FR-008]
- [x] CHK002 Are keyboard operation and an accessible name explicitly specified for the Agent selector? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK003 Is the narrow-window behavior defined beyond the requirement that controls do not overlap? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK004 Is “model information corresponding to the selected Agent” sufficiently precise for both API and CLI options? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK005 Does the spec clearly distinguish API as the built-in Agent from configured CLI choices? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK006 Are the highlight duration and the rule for repeated matches stated consistently across requirements and success criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002–FR-003, SC-001]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK007 Do the requirements explain how users are informed when a compensating write also fails and the session Agent/default cannot be restored to the same state? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-007–FR-009]
- [x] CHK008 Are Agent selection and shared permission settings clearly independent throughout all scenarios? [Consistency, Spec §US3, FR-008, SC-004]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [x] CHK009 Are the behavior for unmatched todo text and deterministic selection among multiple matches complete for existing todos? [Coverage, Spec §US1, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK010 Are the no-current-session and running-state-transition cases fully represented in acceptance scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §US3, FR-007, FR-009]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK011 Can every success criterion be evaluated objectively without relying on implementation-specific details? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Additional Review Topics

- [x] CHK012 Are the three related-file sources, duplicate-path behavior, and empty state clear enough to produce a consistent file list? [Completeness, Spec §US5, FR-014]
- [x] CHK013 Is the fixed-height tool detail area sufficiently specified for short and long content and for narrow/short windows? [Gap, Spec §US4, FR-012]
- [x] CHK014 Is Escape behavior clear when an editor prompt, confirmation, or other dialog is already open? [Coverage, Spec §US5, FR-015]
- [x] CHK015 Are the estimate basis, exclusions, update timing, and visible approximate label clear enough that users will not mistake it for actual model usage? [Clarity, Spec §US6, FR-016–FR-017]
- [x] CHK016 Does the “currently in use” marker clearly mean the default for new sessions rather than a session-level Agent override? [Clarity, Spec §US6, FR-013]
- [x] CHK017 Does removing the pin/close controls leave an unambiguous way to collapse and reopen the project todo card? [Coverage, Spec §US7, FR-018]
- [x] CHK018 Is the additional API/CLI entry in the CLI model menu clearly distinguished from model choices, while preserving all existing model-selection options? [Clarity, Spec §US3, FR-019]
- [x] CHK019 Does the requirement distinguish removing only the floating locator bar from preserving the Alt+Q shortcut, action bar, and record panel? [Completeness, Spec §US8, FR-020]
- [x] CHK020 Is the user-designated context item to remove identifiable and distinct from the Agent name and other required context? [Clarity, Spec §US9, FR-022–FR-023]
- [x] CHK021 Does moving the quick tutorial entry below Settings preserve a discoverable, usable rail order? [Coverage, Spec §US9, FR-024]

## Notes

- 复核记录（2026-10-22）：独立 reviewer（AI Code Manager，受负责人指派）逐项判定 21/21 满足，结论 **APPROVE WITH COMMENTS**；T-054 的审核阻塞解除。
- 低风险遗留意见（不阻塞派发，建议在 T-056/T-058 执行时留意）：CHK001–CHK003 由 FR-006「沿用输入区现有控件样式」继承现有键盘、无障碍与窄窗口行为，API 无可用模型配置时的回退沿用现有模型入口行为（本功能不改变）；CHK013 的短内容场景由「可折叠」语义覆盖，固定高度仅约束长内容上限。
- This checklist evaluates requirement quality only; it is not a test plan for implementation behavior.
